mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, status, messages, context_summary, python_session_id, last_question, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation(user_id, title, status, messages, context_summary, python_session_id, last_question, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{user_id}, #{title}, #{status}, #{messages}, #{context_summary}, #{python_session_id}, #{last_question}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation title = #{title},status = #{status}, messages = #{messages}, context_summary = #{context_summary}, python_session_id = #{python_session_id}, last_question = #{last_question}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_conversation title = #{title}, status = #{status}, context_summary = #{contextSummary}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET messages = JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(COALESCE(messages, JSON_ARRAY()), '$', CAST(#{messageJson} AS JSON)), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET status = 'active', python_session_id = #{pythonSessionId}, title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'general'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
